generated_assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL collectible fantasy card FRAME sculpting concept, NOT a finished card texture. Create a single large portrait 3:4 frame shown perfectly face-on on pale neutral grey, entire silhouette visible. Empty luminous pale grey artwork window occupies the middle and lower majority, with NO illustration. A top independent continuous platinum-and-pale-gold name ribbon lies fully ABOVE the art window; its text channel is empty, wide, uninterrupted and has NO text. Ribbon is structurally joined to a compact emerald-green faceted crystal socket at upper left. Bottom left blue bladed jewel socket and bottom right red shield jewel socket are integrated as the two feet of the frame, not pasted circular badges. Elegant original classical fantasy jewelry construction: fine curving relief leaves only at crown and corners, paired sculpted scrolls, restrained polished bevels, recessed ivory enamel grooves, thin clean side rails with varied thickness, small holding claws and genuinely faceted gems. Silhouette should read as a fine thin metal card, not a heavy wall picture frame; no ornamental wings extending far outside card, no big crown. Expensive luminous platinum with soft antique gold highlights, rich colored jewels, beautiful coherent controlled hierarchy. Fine surface engraving is subtle; no uniform noisy floral wallpaper. Neutral product softbox lighting with obvious geometry and material response. No letters, numbers, text, logos, watermark, characters, artwork, known game design, commercial franchise ornament or copyrighted visual. All motifs original. This is a modeling reference, not final engine art.
